import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
original = root.parent / 'gen-v1'
parent = 'a1349b0a7ffa1420566da9c7770faf80d6be5bf3'
base = '49cd633273a3f61c14a4191a9877e99ab23ec88f'

def git(*args, cwd=root):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=cwd)

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == parent
assert git('rev-parse', 'MERGE_HEAD').decode().strip() == base
assert not git('ls-files', '-u')
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD', cwd=original).decode().strip() == '399cde39ff4ee82272c7a7700944325c44b36070'
assert not git('status', '--porcelain', cwd=original)
lock = digest(Path('pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes())
assert lock == '2269337714e848fd47cca88f898e6d9fd5f70e276a04061e435546ddc9eb9fb9'
ordinary_ci = digest(Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_bytes())
assert ordinary_ci == '4ac906f2a1b060b47971267bab60f0b2b66fed846f3b71f9eabafc7cdc66dca2'

archives = []
for cut, commit, count in [('01', 'fd17d9f1b3931eb2b974b86ccc5a3892da47ba33', 16), ('02', parent, 17)]:
    path = Path(f'docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts/publication-cut-{cut}/archive-manifest.json')
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    assert manifest['publishedCommit'] == commit
    assert manifest['publishedTree'] == git('rev-parse', commit + '^{tree}').decode().strip()
    assert len(manifest['files']) == count
    expected_paths = sorted(name for name in git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', commit, '--', 'docs/implementation/v3').decode().splitlines() if Path(name).parent.as_posix() == 'docs/implementation/v3' and Path(name).name.startswith('M15-'))
    assert sorted(item['path'] for item in manifest['files']) == expected_paths
    for item in manifest['files']:
        expected_archive = path.parent / Path(item['path']).name
        assert item['archive'] == expected_archive.as_posix()
        assert stat.S_ISREG(expected_archive.lstat().st_mode)
        data = expected_archive.read_bytes()
        assert len(data) == item['bytes'] and digest(data) == item['sha256']
        assert data == git('show', commit + ':' + item['path'])
    archives.append({'cut': cut, 'publishedCommit': commit, 'filesVerified': count, 'manifestSha256': digest(path.read_bytes())})

retained = 0
index = {}
for record in git('ls-files', '--stage', '-z', '--', 'docs/implementation/v3/m15-logs', 'docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts').split(b'\0'):
    if record:
        metadata, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, blob, stage = metadata.split()
        assert stage == b'0'
        index[name] = (mode, blob)
for record in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', parent, '--', 'docs/implementation/v3/m15-logs', 'docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts').split(b'\0'):
    if not record:
        continue
    metadata, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
    mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
    assert kind == b'blob' and mode in (b'100644', b'100755')
    assert index[name] == (mode, blob), name
    current = Path(name.decode())
    current_mode = current.lstat().st_mode
    assert stat.S_ISREG(current_mode) and bool(current_mode & 0o111) == (mode == b'100755'), name
    data = current.read_bytes()
    actual = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest().encode()
    assert actual == blob, name
    retained += 1
assert retained == 709

manifest = json.loads(Path('scripts/public-source-files.json').read_bytes())
assert manifest['source'] == sorted(set(manifest['source']))
assert manifest['runtime'] == sorted(set(manifest['runtime']))
assert set(manifest['runtime']) <= set(manifest['source'])
changed = set(git('diff', '--name-only', base).decode().splitlines()) | set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').decode().splitlines())
assert all(path in manifest['source'] for path in changed), sorted(changed - set(manifest['source']))
subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'core.whitespace=cr-at-eol', 'diff', '--check', base, '--', '.', ':(exclude)docs/implementation/v3/m15-logs/**', ':(exclude)docs/implementation/v3/m15-artifacts/**'], check=True)
print(json.dumps({'originalCheckout': 'clean', 'originalHead': '399cde39ff4ee82272c7a7700944325c44b36070', 'publishedParent': parent, 'acceptedBase': base, 'unmergedPaths': 0, 'archives': archives, 'publishedEvidenceFilesUnchanged': retained, 'lockfileSha256': lock, 'ordinaryCiSha256': ordinary_ci, 'publicSourceEntries': len(manifest['source']), 'publicRuntimeEntries': len(manifest['runtime']), 'allCurrentChangesAdmitted': True, 'authoredWhitespace': 'PASS'}, indent=2))
